subject: Billing cutover and VAT details for Solis Bio acquisition
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solisbio.it>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Matteo Bianchi <m.bianchi@solisbio.it>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Billing contact + VAT number for Redwood invoices

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for moving quickly on the contract side. As part of the close we need Redwood to start sending invoices to our Italian ledger (new entity) starting July 1. Can you confirm the billing address and the VAT number that should appear on invoices?

Quick summary of what we need on the invoice:
- Billing name: Solis Bio S.r.l.
- VAT: IT09765432109 (we've attached the certificate)
- Billing address: Via Montebello 12, 20121 Milano, Italy
- Contact for remittance: accounting@solisbio.it and payments@novabank.it

Also let us know if you need any additional documents (W-8/W-9 equivalents, tax residency docs, or a signed PO). We have a DocuSign envelope queued if Redwood prefers a signature for the billing change request.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance
Solis Bio S.r.l.

Attachments: Solis_VAT_certificate.pdf (pdf)

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solisbio.it>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Billing contact + VAT number for Redwood invoices

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear summary and the VAT certificate. We can switch invoice destination to Solis Bio S.r.l. and include the VAT number as provided, effective for invoices dated July 1 onward. A couple of quick items so our billing system and collections team are aligned: 

1) Signed billing-change authorization: we do require an authorization signed by an officer of the acquiring entity for entity-level ledger moves. The DocuSign you mentioned works fine — please CC accounting@redwood.com on the envelope.
2) Bank remittance instructions: for the payment routing change, our collections team will need the bank name, IBAN, and currency preference if wires should go to a different bank.
3) VAT validation: we'll perform a EU VAT reverse-lookup; if anything flags we may follow up for additional proof of registration.

I'll loop in Monica (collections) and Markus (billing ops) to coordinate cutover and to generate a sample invoice for your review.

Next steps:
- Elena: share DocuSign link and (optional) bank remittance details
- Monica/Markus: prepare invoice template and update ledger mapping

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:10:00 +02:00
Subject: Fwd: Billing contact + VAT number for Solis Bio acquisition — action items

Team — forwarding the request from Solis (see below). Time-sensitive: they want invoices starting 2027-07-01. Please do the following: 

- Monica: confirm whether collections needs any additional KYC to accept the new remittance contact accounting@solisbio.it and the bank (if they provide IBAN). If collections wants payment hold-off windows, flag it.
- Markus: create a sample PDF invoice using the billing name/address and VAT number Elena supplied; set invoice entity to "Solis Bio S.r.l." and set effective ledger date 2027-07-01. Use our EU VAT template.
- Aditya: if there are contract clauses that require an amendment for billing entity change, advise. I think legal signed at close covers it, but confirm briefly.

If we can get the DocuSign link and bank details from Elena today, we should be able to issue a test invoice tomorrow.

Thanks — Naomi
